tagline: Only 5 m from the sea, island of Cres
metaDesc: Apartment Punta Blue in Pogana Bay, Punta Križa, island of Cres: ground-floor apartment 5 m from the sea with terrace, sea view, rustic fireplace, air conditioning and free Wi-Fi.
summary: Ground-floor apartment with a rustic fireplace and a terrace just a few steps from the sea.
body:
The holiday house Blue & Orange is situated in Pogana Bay, Punta Križa, only 5 m from the sea, and has two cosy apartments, Punta Blue and Punta Orange, with air conditioning and free Wi-Fi.

The ground-floor apartment Punta Blue has a kitchen with a seating area, a couch that can be extended into a bed, and a rustic fireplace. The bedroom has a double bed, a closet and bed linen. The bathroom has a shower and towels.

The terrace has a seating area just a few steps from the sea. Fantastic sea view from the apartment!
goodToKnow:
Please collect the keys at Restaurant Pogana, a few steps from the apartment.
Free public parking is available about 90 m from the apartment.
The whole apartment and the terrace area are at the guests’ disposal.
The tap water is safe for drinking.
The Wi-Fi login and password can be found in the apartment.
